title: #0 Intro to Investing by the Books

reader_summary.headline: Back here in the studio, and this is a segment called Red Eye Academy.
reader_summary.overview: Back here in the studio, and this is a segment called Red Eye Academy. And part of that is a new type of broadcast that we will launch, which is a podcast. So, and with me, I have Eddie Palmgren and Nikla Zhevos, who are editors here, and also are working with this project.

key_points.text: So tell us a little bit of what you're doing.
key_points.evidence_quote: So tell us a little bit of what you're doing.

key_points.text: The podcast name is investing by the books by Redi.
key_points.evidence_quote: The podcast name is investing by the books by Redi, and the idea is to interview authors and other prominent guests with every kind of literature that is related to investments and how to be a better investor.

key_points.text: And we think that the conversations will be one to one and a half hours approximately.
key_points.evidence_quote: And we think that the conversations will be one to one and a half hours approximately, and we will do release one every other week.

key_points.text: So two per month, that is the idea we have.
key_points.evidence_quote: So two per month, that is the idea we have.
